commands.title: Conformance · toml-test Runner
commands.run: T="$PWD/.build/toml-test" && (cd .build/fixtures/toml-test && go build -o "$T" ./cmd/toml-test) && swift build -c release --package-path Tools/TOMLTestAdapter --scratch-path .build/toml-test-adapter && A="$(swift build -c release --package-path Tools/TOMLTestAdapter --scratch-path .build/toml-test-adapter --show-bin-path)/toml-test-adapter" && for v in 1.0 1.1; do "$T" test -toml "$v" -decoder "$A decode $v" -encoder "$A encode" -color never || exit 1; done
